# Research Interests

My research develops federated and privacy-preserving machine learning for trustworthy AI in medicine: methods that let clinical models learn from distributed hospital data without centralizing patient records, with explicit accounting of communication cost, privacy, and reliability. It builds on a PhD in neuroscience in which I applied machine learning to addiction psychiatry, including overdose risk prediction and clinical decision support.

```{=latex}
\begin{cvlist}
```

\entry{Methods} Federated and continual learning; privacy-preserving and communication-efficient distributed training; deep learning; clinical prediction and risk modelling; natural language processing and large language model tooling; statistical modelling and meta-analysis

\entry{Applications} Federated learning for medical data; addiction psychiatry and the overdose crisis; digital and youth mental health; clinical decision support; maritime surveillance; data science education and AI literacy

```{=latex}
\end{cvlist}
```

# Current Research Projects

```{=latex}
\begin{cvlist}
```

\entry{Ongoing} **FLIP-IT: federated learning for medical data** (IKIM; NEXT.IN.NRW-funded)\
Federated Learning in Practice Networks, co-funded by the European Union and North Rhine-Westphalia, builds infrastructure for decentralized training of medical AI across general practices in NRW (consortium: IKIM, docport, Flower Labs, KVWL, KVNO; project lead: Dr. Nicolas Conze). I build federated chronic kidney disease risk prediction (P(CKD stage $\geq$ 3)) on the Flower framework, with a privacy design of patient-level DP-SGD and SecAgg+ secure aggregation, FedAvg, an RDP privacy accountant with one global ($\varepsilon$, $\delta$) target and per-practice noise calibration, per-round monitoring of global and worst-practice AUROC and sensitivity, and a governance gate with membership-inference leakage audit and clinical and legal review before on-site deployment. With Prof. Jens Kleesiek, Prof. Michael Kamp, and Dr. Moon Kim. [flipit-research.network](https://www.flipit-research.network/)

\entry{Ongoing} **Brain-inspired federated continual learning for healthcare AI**\
Privacy-preserving federated continual learning algorithms (federated synaptic consolidation, federated hippocampal replay, predictive-coding federated learning) that let clinical models learn continuously from distributed hospital data without catastrophic forgetting; open-source benchmark toolkit.

\entry{In progress} **Activation and rank-code communication protocols for federated learning**\
Federated protocols in which clients communicate activation or rank codes (which units fire, and in what order) instead of model parameters, with pre-registered control arms and explicit communication-bitrate accounting.

```{=latex}
\end{cvlist}
```


\entry{2019 -- 2024} **Co-Investigator**, Risk Assessment and Management Platform (RAMP): An online overdose risk score with tailored feedback. Health Canada, Substance Use and Addictions Program. CAD 1,407,790.\
Built the overdose risk prediction models on the BC Provincial Overdose Cohort (2015--2019; N = 36,679): random forest, XGBoost, and support vector machine classifiers on 48 clinical features, with multi-source record linkage, missing-data handling, and severe class imbalance; 91.1% AUROC for general overdose prediction. Identified opioid agonist therapy as consistently protective and polysubstance use, co-occurring depression, and cardiovascular conditions as risk factors. The classifier is deployed as a public web application ([andytai7-odclassifiers.hf.space](https://andytai7-odclassifiers.hf.space)).

## Curriculum Development and Educational Scholarship

- **The Regression Cookbook: Machine Learning and Stats Flavours.** Co-author and curriculum developer of this open textbook funded by the UBC OER Fund. Each method (OLS and GLMs; ridge, lasso, and elastic net; trees and ensembles; structured-data regression) is presented once in both machine learning and statistics idioms, with side-by-side Python and R code, assumptions, diagnostics, and a shared cross-disciplinary glossary. Used in DSCI 551, DSCI 100, and STAT 302. [alexrod61.github.io/regression-cookbook](https://alexrod61.github.io/regression-cookbook/)
- **AI literacy in higher education (TLEF-funded).** Built the statistical analysis framework using cumulative link mixed models and Stuart-Maxwell tests of marginal homogeneity.
- **Responsible generative AI in data science education.** Designed a GenAI policy lab, collaborative brainstorming activities, critical visualization assessment, and AI-resilient assessment for DSCI 531.
- **Course infrastructure.** PrairieLearn assessment and rubric design across MDS courses; Quarto-based course websites; lecture materials on data visualization (Altair, ggplot2), simulation, and AI literacy.

# Supervision and Mentorship

## Capstone Project Supervision, UBC Master of Data Science (DSCI 591)

Industry-partnered applied projects of 8--10 weeks.

- *Nautical Crime Investigation Services.* **Semi-supervised vessel trajectories.** AIS maritime data (about 20 GB); HMM segmentation, LSTM sequence labelling, and random forests; land filtering, vessel ID triage, trip labelling, and a full evaluation framework. Led to a journal article (*Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence*, 2026; corresponding author).
- *BC Children's Hospital.* **CPOE impact evaluation on paediatric laboratory services** (Department of Pathology and Laboratory Medicine; sponsor: Dr. Vilte Barakauskas). Evaluation of computerized provider order entry, ID-band scanning, and electronic ordersets after the February 2022 Cerner go-live; SQL linkage of laboratory information system and EHR extracts within the PHSA PANDA secure enclave; pre- and post-implementation analysis.
- *Vaccine Evaluation Center, BCCHR.* **MedDRA autocoder.** Hybrid retrieval system coding free-text clinical verbatims to MedDRA concepts using biomedical sentence embeddings (SapBERT, BioLORD, BiomedBERT) with lexical re-weighting; Streamlit application with two-stage reviewer adjudication. Top-3 retrieval accuracy of 0.887 on internal evaluation.
- *Creative Destruction Lab.* **Venture dashboard.** Survival analysis (Cox PH), graduation prediction (XGBoost, HistGB), KNN similarity, and GPT-4 feature extraction in a Dockerized Plotly Dash application for early-warning analytics.
- *UBC Cybersecurity.* **Automated phishing detection.** Containerized email classification service with a monitoring dashboard and reproducible deployment.

Capstone presentation evaluator (not supervisor) for projects with Clarius Mobile Health (external demand signals for handheld ultrasound) and VRIFY Technology (deep learning for soil geochemistry prediction).
